title: MILP/MIQCP Differential-Linear Search on SPNs
summary: Bellini et al.’s resource-intensive tool has been practically limited to small ARX variants; whether it can efficiently find differential-linear distinguishers in SPN ciphers remains open.

formal_statement.body: Determine whether the MILP/MIQCP constraint-programming tool of Bellini et al. can efficiently identify differential-linear distinguishers in substitution-permutation-network (SPN) ciphers; its model is resource-intensive and has been limited in application to smaller ARX-cipher variants such as Speck-32.

scope.domain: Automated symmetric cryptanalysis of SPN ciphers using MILP/MIQCP searches for differential-linear distinguishers.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether Bellini et al.’s MILP/MIQCP tool can efficiently identify differential-linear distinguishers in SPN ciphers.

citations.label: Revisiting Differential-Linear Attacks via a Boomerang Perspective With Application to AES, Ascon, CLEFIA, SKINNY, PRESENT, KNOT, TWINE, WARP, LBlock, Simeck and SERPENT

progress.summary: The source describes Bellini et al.’s model as resource-intensive and practically limited to small Speck variants such as Speck-32. It explicitly leaves that tool’s efficiency on SPN ciphers open.
